Avengers Endgame: Encore returns to theaters Friday 🍿🔥

🎥🎬: Avengers: Endgame

After losing half of the universe to Thanos, the surviving Avengers spend years living with the consequences of their failure. Hope returns when Scott Lang reveals that the Quantum Realm could provide a way to travel through time.

The Avengers use the opportunity to revisit the past and collect the Infinity Stones before returning to their present. Their mission forces them to confront old enemies, painful memories, and moments from their own history.

But their plan draws Thanos’ attention, leading to a massive battle that brings heroes from across the universe together. In the final confrontation, the Avengers fight not only to defeat Thanos but to give the lost a chance to return.
